title: 5 money habits that keep you poor without realizing

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 72% of people who struggle with money do it daily?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This habit is silently wrecking your finances right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s spending on things you don’t really need — like daily coffee runs.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know the average person spends $1,200 a year on coffee alone?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects young professionals and side-hustlers who think they’re saving.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key insight? You’re not broke — you’re just spending wrong.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one habit you’re doing that’s costing you money?
